I don't hold the design review notes. My ticket's note only covered case-insensitivity (codes returned upper-cased). For your question: parse_edge returns an ordered pair (from, to), so "BER-HAM" and "HAM-BER" are distinct records at the parse level. Whether graph_diff treats them as the same road is a decision I don't have visibility into. Sorry I can't help more.
